name: Fangzhou Inc.
summary: Fangzhou Inc. provides online chronic disease management services in China. It operates through four segments: Online Retail Pharmacy Services; Comprehensive Medical Services; Wholesale; and Customized Content and Marketing Solutions. The company offers services through an online chronic disease management platform to address the needs of patients with chronic diseases, such as hypertension, cardiovascular and respiratory diseases.
